results.title: Ji.hlava30: Thinking through film
results.overview: What all is happening and unfolding between the world, the camera, and the audience? This edited film, composed of footage from the festival’s “Minutes from Jihlava to the Mind” series, masterclass recordings, and interviews, weaves together the reflections of guests at the Ji.hlava International Documentary Film Festival on how meaning is created, what film representation does to reality, and how rhythm, editing, sound, and creative choices transform our perception of the reality being depicted. The filmmakers’ perspectives, methods, and questions about the nature of the documentary come together in a reflection on film as a means of understanding and as a space where one can question, discover connections, and rethink the world and one’s own view of it.

results.title: Miss Holloween
results.overview: Halloween has come to Hatchetfield, and with it an army of demonic monster-masks who set out to terrorize the tiny town. The only one standing in their way is Hatchetfield's mysterious, witchy guardian, Miss Holloway. But when she makes a deadly deal with the Lords In Black, Miss Holloway is in for more tricks than treats.

results.title: Ho‘olono
results.overview: Hoʻolono, meaning “to listen deeply,” is a cinematic act of listening and an exploration of return, responsibility, and our evolving relationship to land and self. Hoʻolono is an invitation to listen deeply, to remember that the path through ecological crisis may also be a path back to ourselves.

results.title: Polygala Paniculata
results.overview: This short student auto-documentary narrates a day in Ngari Mulholland's life that she believes changed her, resembling a format similar to the Australian MY:24 documentary series. It explores, despite being young, the presence of an impactful life lesson through a retrospective lense and ventures into personal discovery, teenagehood and a hopefulness in her inner person that she carries in her life now.
